448.trigger: Queixa de ansiedade/sono ruim sem causa orgânica aparente, ou quando exames médicos indicam "sem lesão orgânica".

414.skill_name: Excluir problemas psicológicos graves com base na manutenção e limitação da função
414.skill_description: Verificar se as funções de aprendizado, interpessoais e comportamentais estão mantidas em geral, se o problema está limitado a um relacionamento/cenário específico, se a duração é inferior a dois meses; se a função estiver completa e não generalizada, em princípio, excluir problemas psicológicos graves.
414.when_to_use: Antes da classificação da gravidade e da decisão de encaminhamento.
414.trigger: Pode participar de atividades escolares e interagir normalmente, a dificuldade está limitada a um único contexto ou flutuações de curto prazo.

292.skill_name: Interview-based assessment and grading of suicide/self-harm risk
292.skill_description: Specifically inquire about suicidal ideation, frequency, recent occurrence, methods, and planning, combined with recent behavior and functioning, record the risk level (e.g., occasional thoughts but controllable -> low risk) and protective factors, to guide safety and intervention arrangements.
292.when_to_use: During depression symptom assessment and work diagnosis, or when negative thoughts and functional decline occur.
292.trigger: Client reports suicidal thoughts, feelings of hopelessness, or a history of self-harm, even if frequency is low and controllable.

321.skill_name: Initiate crisis intervention and safety management for high-risk situations
321.skill_description: After confirming the presence of suicidal ideation/intent and self-harm history or other high-risk clues, promptly initiate crisis intervention procedures, sign safety agreements if necessary, and strengthen the support network, to ensure safety and gain time for subsequent treatment.
321.when_to_use: During the initial interview or assessment update, immediately manage if the assessment is determined to be medium-high risk.
321.trigger: Client describes specific self-harm/suicide plans or has engaged in dangerous behavior, frequent impulsivity and extreme distress.

318.skill_name: Identify triggers, main problems, and comorbidity relationships
318.skill_description: Organize specific triggering events (e.g., exams, breakups) and their association with symptoms, determine the main problem (e.g., anxiety predominates) and identify comorbidities or primary/secondary relationships such as anxiety causing depression, to classify as general psychological problems and determine intervention priority.
318.when_to_use: During the diagnostic assessment phase, when locating symptom triggers and problem hierarchies is required.
318.trigger: Reports recent significant stimuli events accompanied by anxiety/sleep disturbance and learning impairment, scales indicate prominent main dimension.

187.skill_name: Organize and state diagnostic basis and preliminary conclusions
187.skill_description: Integrate scales, observations, and differential conclusions into clear items (e.g., course, functional impairment, generalization) to form a preliminary diagnosis or work diagnosis and record exclusion pathways and supporting evidence, explain to the client if necessary to enhance understanding.
187.when_to_use: When providing and recording diagnostic conclusions after completing the scaling, interview, and differential process.
187.trigger: Sufficient evidence (e.g., scales indicate mild to moderate, limited functional impairment), ensuring diagnosis is transparent and traceable.

522.skill_name: Apply the "Three Principles" and differentiate and exclude item by item
522.skill_description: Check for congruence of objective and subjective aspects, internal coordination, and personality stability according to the "three principles" of illness and non-illness, self-awareness, and the presence of hallucinations or delusions; and combine with whether there are chronic conflicts, functional impairment, and course/generalization, to exclude psychotic, neurotic, and severe psychological problems item by item.
522.when_to_use: After preliminary diagnosis, to ensure diagnostic accuracy when excluding other categories of disorders.
522.trigger: No signs of psychosis, intact self-awareness; conflicts have real significance and limited social functional impairment, short course.

352.skill_name: Interpret psychological assessments and recommend medical evaluation when necessary
352.skill_description: Integrate assessment results from SCL-90, SAS, SDS, etc., with normative data to establish the symptom spectrum and severity (e.g., mild depression/no obvious anxiety) as diagnostic corroboration; when depressive tendency and functional impairment persist, recommend further diagnosis and evaluation of the need for drug treatment at the hospital.
352.when_to_use: When completing psychological assessments or when objective indicators are needed to calibrate diagnosis and whether medical evaluation is required.
352.trigger: Scale scores indicate abnormality accompanied by persistent symptoms such as insomnia, or when the chief complaint and scale need cross-validation.

219.skill_name: Re-test and follow-up comparison to update diagnostic impression
219.skill_description: Repeat testing with scales such as SAS/SDS during the intervention follow-up period and conduct follow-up interviews, compare changes before and after (e.g., anxiety/depression decreasing from moderate to mild), revise the diagnosis and plan accordingly, and record progress.
219.when_to_use: After the start of preliminary intervention or at stage-specific assessment points, when evaluating treatment efficacy and state evolution is required.
219.trigger: Entering the follow-up phase or the client reports a change in state, when abnormal previous scores need to be verified for improvement trend.

311.skill_name: Differentiate and exclude neurotic/anxious neurotic disorders
311.skill_description: Refer to neurotic characteristics, check the degree of distress, social functional impairment, presence of avoidance and generalization, and course (e.g., whether it exceeds six months), and combine with the reality of the conflict and the score results to judge whether the neurotic criteria are met; if not met, exclude it.
311.when_to_use: When there are obvious anxiety/depressive symptoms but the nature and persistence need clarification.
311.trigger: Anxiety is directly related to real events, short course, basic function is maintained, no signs of widespread avoidance or generalization.

518.skill_name: Interpreting SCL-90 Symptom Dimensions and Severity
518.skill_description: Based on the total score, positive items, and factor scores of the SCL-90, identify high-score dimensions such as interpersonal sensitivity, depression, anxiety, paranoia, etc., to define overall severity and symptom profile, assisting in forming quantitative basis for diagnosis and follow-up.
518.when_to_use: After completing the psychological assessment, for severity definition before diagnostic judgment.
518.trigger: When SCL-90 factor scores or total scores are significantly elevated, and abnormal dimensions and overall severity need to be determined.

226.skill_name: Administering and Interpreting Quantitative Severity of SCL-90/SAS/SDS
226.skill_description: After consent, administer SCL-90, SAS, and SDS, calculate standard scores and factor scores, determine the severity of anxiety/depression and related dimensions, and record the results as objective basis and baseline for diagnosis and treatment efficacy assessment.
226.when_to_use: For the initial assessment or when a more comprehensive understanding of emotional state and severity is needed to establish a baseline.
226.trigger: When the client reports anxiety, irritability, sleep/appetite problems, or when comparing before and after changes.

211.skill_name: Applying the 'Illness vs. Non-Illness Three Principles' to Differentiate Pathological Conditions and Rule Out Psychotic Issues
211.skill_description: Verify the unity of subjective and objective, coordination of psychological activity, and personality stability based on the three principles, assess self-awareness and the presence of hallucinations or delusions, to distinguish normal reactions from psychological disorders and rule out psychotic issues, clarifying whether it falls within the scope of psychological counseling.
211.when_to_use: In the early stages of assessment and diagnosis, to distinguish psychotic issues from general psychological problems and determine the boundary between illness and non-illness.
211.trigger: Although there are complaints such as anxiety and insomnia, logical thinking is normal, emotions and situations are commensurate, and social functioning is basically intact.

217.skill_name: Implementing and Recording PCL-C/SAS/SCL-90 Assessment and Interpretation
217.skill_description: Select PCL-C, SAS, SCL-90, etc., for administration, fully record raw scores, factor scores, and positive items, interpret according to threshold systems, and form a preliminary diagnostic impression, serving as a basis for diagnostic judgment and severity grading.
217.when_to_use: In the middle stage of an assessment interview, when objective quantification of symptom severity is needed to provide evidence for diagnosis.
217.trigger: When there are persistent low mood, insomnia, severe anxiety, or functional impairment, and a scale quantification and diagnostic support are required.

458.skill_name: Identificar conflitos de forma para excluir problemas neuróticos
458.skill_description: Determinar se o conflito psicológico é provocado por fatores reais e compatível com a situação, com conotação moral e características formais; quando a reação emocional é compreensível e não generalizada, excluir problemas neuróticos, evitando a patologização excessiva.
458.when_to_use: Na fase de diagnóstico diferencial, ao diferenciar de problemas neuróticos.
458.trigger: O problema origina-se de eventos reais como trabalho/estudo/relacionamentos íntimos, com um alcance e objeto de reação limitados, e a função permanece basicamente estável.

357.skill_name: Screening symptom spectrum and comorbidity tendency with SCL-90
357.skill_description: Medir e interpretar a pontuação total e a pontuação dos fatores do SCL-90, marcar as dimensões com pontuação ≥2 (como depressão, ansiedade, TOC, sensibilidade interpessoal, etc.), identificar o espectro de sintomas e pistas de comorbidade potencial, como referência para a formulação do plano e comparação de acompanhamento.
357.when_to_use: Necessário rastreamento amplo de outros sintomas psicológicos ou suspeita de comorbidade, e ao estabelecer a linha de base.
357.trigger: Além do problema principal, relatar outras perturbações, ou quando múltiplos fatores estão elevados no questionário, requer avaliação integrada.

163.skill_name: Corroborar o diagnóstico com resultados de SCL-90/SAS/EPQ, etc.
163.skill_description: Integrate assessment results from SCL-90, SAS/SDS, and EPQ, focusing on anxiety factors and standard scores, severity of depression, and personality traits, calibrate consistency with clinical interview, and adjust diagnostic hypotheses as necessary, clarifying key dimensions.
163.when_to_use: Quando é necessária assistência de indicadores objetivos para diagnóstico e estratificação após a entrevista, ou quando o julgamento clínico precisa ser calibrado após a conclusão da avaliação.
163.trigger: Quando o resultado da escala está disponível e indica aumento de dimensão ou tendência de personalidade relacionada, deve ser cruzado com a queixa principal.

478.skill_name: Excluir psicose grave combinando os 'três princípios' com autoconhecimento
478.skill_description: Com base nos três princípios de atividade mental normal e anormal, combinando a autoconsciência, a busca ativa por ajuda e a ausência de sinais de alucinação ou delírios, desordem do pensamento, registrar as razões para excluir psicose grave, completar o diagnóstico diferencial chave e direcionar para o diagnóstico subsequente.
478.when_to_use: Na fase de triagem e diagnóstico precoce para distinguir a presença de psicose psicótica.
478.trigger: O paciente é capaz de reconhecer a anomalia e buscar ajuda ativamente, contato social bom, sem sintomas psicóticos.

435.skill_name: Explicar e fornecer os resultados da escala ao paciente e familiares
435.skill_description: Utilize explanatory techniques to provide visitors and their fathers with SDS/SAS scores and meanings, clarify the current status and risks, enhance consistent understanding of the issue, promote motivation for cooperation and subsequent intervention, and link to subsequent plans.
435.when_to_use: na fase de feedback durante a primeira consulta ou avaliação, após a conclusão da aplicação da escala e obtenção dos resultados.
435.trigger: O teste mostrou resultados de depressão leve ou ansiedade moderada, o paciente e a família têm dúvidas sobre o significado da pontuação e os planos futuros ou precisam de uma compreensão unificada.

317.skill_name: Interpretar e registrar os resultados da escala para determinar a gravidade e as características
317.skill_description: Organize and interpret assessment results, such as judging anxiety levels based on SAS, identify significant symptom domains by combining SCL-90 factors and total score, determine personality tendencies by referring to EPQ, and record the conclusions in the assessment and diagnosis, providing a basis for subsequent goals and plans.
317.when_to_use: Após a conclusão da medição e obtenção da pontuação, para redigir a avaliação e o diagnóstico ou discutir os resultados com o paciente.
317.trigger: Gerar relatório de teste contendo pontuações chave, fatores e informações de dimensão de personalidade.

436.skill_name: Repetir SAS/SDS e comparar a avaliação do efeito da consulta antes e depois
436.skill_description: Antes da consolidação e término, fazer com que o visitante preencha novamente os questionários de autoavaliação de ansiedade e depressão, comparar as mudanças nas pontuações antes e depois, para avaliar objetivamente o efeito da consulta e como base para a avaliação de fase ou encerramento; registrar as mudanças nas pontuações padrão para avaliação do efeito e ajuste do plano.
436.when_to_use: Ao consultar no estágio tardio ou ao finalizar a avaliação, é necessário revisar a eficácia de forma quantificada.
436.trigger: Há sinais de melhora nos sintomas ou é necessário verificar objetivamente e registrar o efeito da intervenção, preparar para avaliação de fase ou encerrar a consulta.

432.skill_name: Avaliação inicial para estabelecer a linha de base SAS/SDS
432.skill_description: Medir SAS e SDS na avaliação inicial, quantificar o grau de ansiedade e depressão, obter pontuações padrão e classificação clínica, como linha de base para comparação com o diagnóstico e reavaliações subsequentes, e complementar as informações da entrevista.
432.when_to_use: Na fase de avaliação e diagnóstico psicológico (primeira consulta), quando é necessária uma quantificação objetiva dos sintomas de ansiedade e depressão.
432.trigger: Perturbações emocionais como tristeza, inquietação, agitação, sono ruim, queda na eficiência de estudo, etc., necessitam de avaliação da gravidade.

283.skill_name: Administrar SAS/SDS/SCL-90 na primeira consulta e quantificar sintomas
283.skill_description: Administrar SAS, SDS e SCL-90 na fase de avaliação inicial, obter escores padronizados e escores fatoriais, quantificar sintomas como ansiedade, fornecer base para diagnóstico preliminar e julgamento da gravidade do problema.
283.when_to_use: Na fase de diagnóstico da consulta inicial, quando for necessário quantificar objetivamente sintomas como ansiedade e insônia.
283.trigger: O paciente relata ansiedade, palpitações, insônia, etc.; a descrição verbal é insuficiente para determinar a gravidade ou quando é necessário quantificar a informação objetivamente.

351.skill_name: Comparar resultados antes e depois e avaliar a eficácia da consulta
351.skill_description: Repetir a administração do SCL-90, SAS e SDS antes e depois da consulta, comparar as mudanças nos escores e calcular a taxa de redução, combinando com a melhoria da função social, para avaliar quantitativamente a eficácia da intervenção e o resultado do tratamento.
351.when_to_use: Na fase de avaliação/encerramento ou quando for necessário resumir os resultados do tratamento.
351.trigger: Conclusão de um ciclo de intervenção, necessidade de quantificar o efeito do tratamento ou decisão sobre ajustar o plano.

162.skill_name: Analisar e fornecer feedback dos resultados dos testes para elaborar o plano de consulta
162.skill_description: Combinar os escores do SCL-90, SAS, EPQ com as declarações do paciente, explicar e fornecer feedback sobre os resultados dos testes, e com base nisso definir a natureza e a gravidade do problema, determinando assim o método de consulta e os objetivos subsequentes.
162.when_to_use: Após a administração dos testes na consulta inicial, na etapa de feedback dos resultados e elaboração do plano de consulta.
162.trigger: Os escores dos testes foram concluídos e é necessário informar ao paciente sobre as descobertas da avaliação e definir o método e o plano de consulta subsequentes.

316.skill_name: Após obter consentimento, selecionar e administrar questionários específicos
316.skill_description: Com base nas características do problema do paciente, após obter seu consentimento, selecionar questionários mais específicos (como SAS, SCL-90, EPQ) para administração, obter dados padronizados, complementar o material da sessão e fornecer base para o julgamento da gravidade e das características da personalidade.
316.when_to_use: Na fase de diagnóstico ou avaliação, quando for necessário obter informações quantificadas objetivamente para apoiar o julgamento e a definição de objetivos.
316.trigger: O paciente apresenta queixas de ansiedade, distúrbios do sono, problemas interpessoais, etc., e consente em realizar os testes psicológicos.

296.skill_name: Administer and interpret SAS to determine anxiety severity
296.skill_description: Use the Anxiety Self-Rating Scale (SAS) for standardized assessment, calculate and interpret standard scores, quantify current anxiety level, assist in determining the presence or absence of anxiety symptoms, and cross-reference with interview information, as a reference for subsequent intervention.
296.when_to_use: When quantifying mental state during the initial interview, or when the client reports anxiety-related symptoms such as mood fluctuations, insomnia, or worry.
296.trigger: Client reports significant mood fluctuations, long-term insomnia, worry about the future; need to objectify the anxiety level.

303.skill_name: Integrate assessment and symptom data to form diagnostic tendency
303.skill_description: Comprehensively analyze SAS, SDS scores with the client's symptom descriptions, impairment in social functioning, etc., to judge the tendency for obsessive tendencies and accompanying anxiety and depression levels, form a preliminary diagnosis and problem statement, and incorporate test results into the diagnostic basis.
303.when_to_use: When making assessment and diagnostic conclusions after the initial interview and scale assessment.
303.trigger: SAS/SDS results obtained, and key information such as symptom duration and functional impact is known.

450.skill_name: Periodic re-testing of SDS/SAS to monitor changes and treatment efficacy
450.skill_description: Administer SDS and SAS at key points during counseling (such as early and ninth sessions), compare scores before and after to evaluate mood changes and intervention effects, provide basis for plan adjustment and termination.
450.when_to_use: Before and after the middle and consolidation phases of formal counseling, or when re-testing is needed to monitor progress.
450.trigger: Need to evaluate treatment efficacy or consider phase transition/termination; client's state shows significant improvement or persistent distress.

134.skill_name: Interpret SDS/SAS scores to determine severity and form conclusions
134.skill_description: Based on SDS and SAS scores and cut-off ranges, determine the level of depression/anxiety (e.g., mild, moderate, severe), form a concise conclusion for assessment, communication, and record-keeping, supporting subsequent decisions.
134.when_to_use: After the scale scores are available, used in the case assessment summary and preliminary diagnosis stage.
134.trigger: SDS or SAS scores indicate high or medium levels, requiring clarification of the nature and severity of the problem.

234.skill_name: Recomendar consulta para diagnóstico com base nos resultados da escala
234.skill_description: Quando os resultados da escala indicam ansiedade moderada ou depressão de intensidade moderada a grave, informar ao entrevistado sobre as conclusões do teste e recomendar a procura de uma instituição médica especializada para avaliação diagnóstica adicional, a fim de obter opiniões de tratamento padronizadas.
234.when_to_use: Quando a pontuação da escala atingir o limiar diagnóstico relevante ou indicar problemas moderados a graves, e for necessária um diagnóstico médico e recomendação de tratamento.
234.trigger: Pontuação SAS padrão de aproximadamente 63 indica ansiedade moderada; índice SDS de aproximadamente 0.62 indica depressão de intensidade moderada a grave.

332.skill_name: Repetir a medição em fases e comparar as pontuações antes e depois para avaliar o efeito da intervenção
332.skill_description: Repetir a mesma escala em um ponto de intervenção ou fase e comparar as mudanças nas pontuações antes e depois, avaliando o efeito e o grau de melhora dos sintomas, usando dados para verificar o alcance dos objetivos.
332.when_to_use: Quando o paciente estiver na fase de consolidação ou resumo, e for necessário avaliar o efeito da intervenção.
332.trigger: Conclusão do número de intervenções estabelecido ou necessidade de verificar o alcance dos objetivos e a mudança nos sintomas.

242.skill_name: Repetir a mesma escala e comparar para avaliar a mudança na eficácia do tratamento
242.skill_description: Repetir a mesma escala na fase de avaliação de resultados, comparar as mudanças nas pontuações antes e depois para determinar se a ansiedade, etc., melhoraram, quantificar o efeito da intervenção e a tendência de mudança, para resumo de fase ou decisão de término.
242.when_to_use: No resumo de fase ou ao encerrar a consulta, para avaliar o efeito do tratamento e a tendência de mudança.
242.trigger: Necessidade de verificar objetivamente a mudança nos sintomas e a eficácia do tratamento após um período de implementação da intervenção.

524.skill_name: Aplicar a escala SAS para avaliar o nível de ansiedade e determinar o grau
524.skill_description: Usar a escala SAS para avaliar a intensidade da emoção ansiosa do entrevistado, calcular a pontuação total e determinar a gravidade de acordo com os padrões da escala (como moderada), formar uma conclusão quantitativa, como referência para o julgamento e intervenção do problema de ansiedade.
524.when_to_use: No primeiro atendimento ou antes da intervenção, quando for necessário quantificar o nível de ansiedade e determinar a gravidade.
524.trigger: O entrevistado relata medo, tensão e inquietação como queixas principais, e é necessário definir o grau de ansiedade.

533.skill_name: Administer SDS to quantify depression severity and interpret results
533.skill_description: Use SDS in the initial interview to quantitatively assess the degree of depression, record raw score and standard score, interpret according to norms, and clarify current depression severity, supplement interview information to provide a basis for subsequent goals and plans.
533.when_to_use: In the initial diagnosis or assessment phase, when objective understanding of depression severity is needed, and when supplementing interview information.
533.trigger: Client reports persistent low mood, insomnia, irritability, suicidal ideation, and other depression-related symptoms.

150.skill_name: Administer and interpret SCL-90 to quantify multidimensional symptom profile
150.skill_description: Administer and interpret the total score, number of positive items, and scores for each factor of the SCL-90, identify prominent dimensions such as anxiety, depression, interpersonal sensitivity, hostility, etc., quantify the range and severity of symptoms, provide objective basis for assessment and conceptualization.
150.when_to_use: In the initial assessment phase, when objective understanding of the symptom profile and breadth of distress is needed, and to provide a baseline for conceptualization and goal setting.
150.trigger: Client reports various discomforts such as anxiety, restlessness, sleep problems, and verbal information is insufficient to define severity or range.

278.skill_name: Compare pre- and post-measure to quantitatively present treatment efficacy and change
278.skill_description: Repeat the same scale in the later stages of counseling, compare the change in scores before and after (e.g., addiction, social avoidance, sleep, AAQ-II), test the effectiveness of the intervention, and summarize the results to support case closure assessment.
278.when_to_use: When counseling enters the summary or stage assessment phase, used to verify the extent of improvement and achievement of goals.
278.trigger: Objective verification of change after multiple interventions or to provide evidence of counseling effectiveness.

267.skill_name: Administer SCL-90 and complete informed consent to establish baseline
267.skill_description: In the initial interview assessment phase, explain and complete informed consent, guide the completion of the record form including the SCL-90, obtain quantitative baseline data for symptoms such as depression and anxiety, to provide a basis for subsequent assessment and plan development.
267.when_to_use: In the first phase of assessment and the phase of establishing the therapeutic relationship (1st to 2nd session), when establishing a quantitative baseline is required.
267.trigger: Start of the initial consultation, when a systematic understanding of the client's symptom status or abnormality is indicated, leading to assessment.

272.skill_name: Monitor efficacy by comparing SCL-90 before and after
272.skill_description: Administer the SCL-90 assessment before and after the intervention to compare changes in factors such as somatization, depression, and anxiety, to objectively evaluate symptom improvement and reduction in subjective distress, to provide evidence for efficacy judgment.
272.when_to_use: During phase review or at the end of a phase, when evaluating the effect of the intervention.
272.trigger: When treatment reaches a predetermined point (such as the end of a phase or case closure), or when the client reports symptom changes requiring objective verification.

440.skill_name: Re-test SCL-90 and assess effect by comparison
440.skill_description: Re-test the SCL-90 (and TAS) after the intervention or before case closure, compare with the initial assessment, observe whether factor scores return to the normal range, to evaluate the relief of anxiety and consulting effectiveness.
440.when_to_use: During phase assessment or before ending consultation, when needing to verify the timing of intervention effect and symptom improvement.
440.trigger: When the client reports reduced anxiety, ability to concentrate on learning, and social improvement, requiring quantitative data to confirm subjective improvement.

483.skill_name: Re-measure at follow-up to monitor maintenance effect
483.skill_description: Re-administer the scale consistent with the baseline (such as SDS, LSAS, AIS/SAS) at the end of consultation or at follow-up points, compare scores and level changes, to evaluate the maintenance of efficacy and symptom changes, as a basis for follow-up and subsequent recommendations.
483.when_to_use: At the end of the consultation phase or during follow-up assessment, when needing to objectively quantify efficacy changes or maintenance status.
483.trigger: At follow-up after two or three months, when client subjective feedback of improvement requires quantitative verification or reporting symptom fluctuations.

504.skill_name: Administer and interpret EPQ to identify personality traits
504.skill_description: Administer the EPQ and report scores for the E, N, P, and L dimensions, to identify personality backgrounds such as extraversion-introversion, emotional instability, and masking tendencies, to assist in case conceptualization and plan selection.
504.when_to_use: Initial assessment to understand the impact of personality traits on the problem, to support case conceptualization and risk identification.
504.trigger: When the client exhibits characteristics such as sensitivity, impulsivity, or hostility in interpersonal and emotional reactions, and personality tendencies are unclear.
